summary: Verified the Reps/Week chart fix (iteration 7). Seeded localStorage with Monday session (push-ups 15/12/12, ab-wheel 10, plank 60 timed) + Tuesday session (band rows 15/15/12). History chart's current-week bucket correctly reflected 91 reps (plank 60 excluded via isDuration filter). Auto-fill on empty commit works for strength (12 from '12–15'), band (12 from '12–15'), and timed (45 from '45–60s' with isDuration=true) exercises. Manual override ('18') stored correctly. Placeholders show correct target ('12' for reps, '45s' for timed). Cardio single (Mini Stepper Intervals) stored with isDuration=true, chart total unchanged (42 -> 42). Stat tile This Week = 2/5 correct. All 7 acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Recharts logs a benign width/height(-1) warning on initial render before ResponsiveContainer measures the parent; not user-visible but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: storage.js repsByWeek: correctly guards with !x.isDuration + Number.isFinite + >0; solid.

ExerciseCard SetRow commit: auto-fill uses targetDefault (Number) when empty, but if the user types a non-numeric string it will still be stored as-is (e.g. 'abc'). repsByWeek then filters via Number.isFinite so chart is safe, but consider validating input at commit time.

Today.jsx handleLogSingle: stamps isDuration:true unconditionally on singles. This is correct for cardio/timed singles (all current singles are cardio). If a rep-count 'single' is ever added, this would need reconsideration.
SetRow value state initialises from log?.reps ?? '' — good; but changing exercise data (targetDefault) after mount won't update state until user edits, which is fine given static plan.
seed_data_creation: Programmatically seeded localStorage 'homeshred:sessions' with a Monday + Tuesday session for chart verification; cleared before Today auto-fill tests. No backend seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App base URL requires /Gym/ path (CRA homepage). Force training day via page.add_init_script("Date.prototype.getDay=function(){return N;}") + reload. localStorage key 'homeshred:sessions' shape documented in review request. Chart aggregator repsByWeek skips isDuration entries and non-finite/non-positive reps.
